name: Nahum
summary: A prophet from Elkosh whose whole book is a vision that Nineveh, the bloody city, would be laid waste. Scripture tells nothing more about him and names no one else alongside him.

key_moments.title: Tells Judah Its Yoke Will Be Broken
key_moments.description: Nahum said the LORD is slow to anger but takes vengeance on His enemies, and is a strong hold in the day of trouble. He told Judah the LORD would break its enemy's yoke, and to keep its feasts, for the wicked would pass through no more.

key_moments.title: Says Nineveh Will Be Laid Waste
key_moments.description: Nahum saw chariots raging in the streets and Nineveh's people fleeing as its treasure was taken. He cried woe to the bloody city full of lies and robbery, and said all who saw it would say, Nineveh is laid waste.
